name: house
about: The live-test house (Haiku over MCP, 2026-09-26/27) redrawn with the long labels agents actually write: absolute coordinates, shapes sized for one word, a door and a window placed inside unlabelled walls, and a note beside the frame. Nothing overlaps at the authored sizes; every label is longer than its shape.

ops.title: Our cozy home on the hill

ops.text: red tiled roof with a brick chimney
front door with a brass knocker
old oak tree planted by grandpa
A cozy home where the whole team gathers on Fridays
Ask the designer whether the roof should be flat or pitched before we pick colours
